facts: Current Board: 14 directors, all incumbent nominees for May 11, 2023; if elected, they serve until the next annual meeting or a qualified successor.
The Nominating and Governance Committee recommended reducing Board size from 15 to 14 upon Earley’s retirement.
All 14 then-current Board members attended the prior virtual annual meeting.
Kimberly A. Casiano: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2003.
Alexandra Ford English: incumbent nominee; director since 2021.
James D. Farley, Jr.: incumbent nominee; director since 2020.
Henry Ford III: incumbent nominee; director since 2021.
William Clay Ford, Jr.: incumbent nominee; director since 1988.
William W. Helman IV: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2011.
Jon M. Huntsman, Jr.: incumbent nominee; director since 2020 (also 2012–2017).
William E. Kennard: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2015.
John C. May: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2021.
Beth E. Mooney: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2019.
Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2017.
John L. Thornton: incumbent nominee; independent director since 1996.
John B. Veihmeyer: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2017.
John S. Weinberg: incumbent nominee; independent director since 2016.
Alexandra Ford English remained a Board director after leaving her employee role on June 17, 2022; she served as a non-employee director in June–December 2022.
The Board found nine nominees independent with no material relationship: Casiano, Helman, Kennard, May, Mooney, Vojvodich Radakovich, Thornton, Veihmeyer and Weinberg; 64% of nominees.
William Clay Ford, Jr. is not independent under Ford’s Corporate Governance Principles.
The Board found Earley independent during his service, including the filing-described heightened SEC independence standards for compensation committees.
William Clay Ford, Jr. is Board Chair, separately from CEO Farley; Chair since January 1999 and Executive Chair since September 2006.
John L. Thornton is Lead Independent Director, a position held since 2022.
Five standing committees exist: Audit; Compensation, Talent and Culture; Finance; Nominating and Governance; Sustainability, Innovation and Policy.
Audit has three members: John B. Veihmeyer (Chair), Kimberly A. Casiano and Beth E. Mooney.
Compensation, Talent and Culture has four members: Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich (Chair), John C. May, John L. Thornton and John S. Weinberg.

Finance: William Clay Ford, Jr. (Chair), Alexandra Ford English, Henry Ford III, William W. Helman IV, William E. Kennard, John C. May, John L. Thornton and John S. Weinberg. Ford has chaired since 2007 and previously 1995–October 2001.

Nominating and Governance: William E. Kennard (Chair), Kimberly A. Casiano, William W. Helman IV, John C. May, Beth E. Mooney, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich, John L. Thornton, John B. Veihmeyer and John S. Weinberg.

Sustainability, Innovation and Policy: William W. Helman IV (Chair), Kimberly A. Casiano, Alexandra Ford English, Henry Ford III, William Clay Ford, Jr., Jon M. Huntsman, Jr., William E. Kennard, Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich and John S. Weinberg.
All Audit members meet NYSE, SEC and Ford independence standards, including heightened SEC audit-committee standards.
The Board additionally found Casiano, Mooney, Vojvodich Radakovich and Veihmeyer independent under heightened SEC audit-committee standards.
All Compensation, Talent and Culture members are independent; the Board specifically found May, Vojvodich Radakovich, Thornton and Weinberg meet additional NYSE compensation-committee standards.
All Nominating and Governance members are independent under NYSE, SEC and Ford standards.
The filing states each Audit member meets NYSE financial-literacy requirements.
The Board determined John B. Veihmeyer is an Audit Committee financial expert under SEC regulations and applicable NYSE rules.

During 2022, Compensation, Talent and Culture comprised Earley (until May 12), May, Vojvodich Radakovich, Thornton and Weinberg; none was an employee or current/former officer during service or had a disclosure-requiring relationship.
Anthony F. Earley, Jr. retired from the Board following the May 2022 shareholder meeting and did not stand for re-election.
Alexandra Ford English was first elected to the Board at the 2021 Annual Meeting.
Henry Ford III was first elected to the Board at the 2021 Annual Meeting.
Farley’s nominee card states committee service N/A.
